quality_effect: Keeps horizontal transformation, vertical datum and terrain-surface error as separate uncertainty terms.

official_sources.name: OS future of British mapping coordinate systems
OS datum ellipsoid and projection information

verified_facts: OSGB36 and ODN remain the basis of OS mapping
OSTN15 is the National Grid transformation
OSGM15 is the national geoid model used to access ODN heights
ETRS89 GNSS coordinates can be transformed to OSGB36 and ODN
EPSG:27700 identifies OSGB36 British National Grid
OSTN15 and OSGM15 are transformation models rather than terrain models
Datum transformation uncertainty must not be treated as terrain surface RMSE
